records.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new refresh-token fetch checks `if (response.statusText !== "OK")` and throws a 400. `statusText` is not a reliable success indicator across fetch implementations/proxies (and can be empty or non-"OK" even when `response.ok`/status is 200), so this can incorrectly fail successful refresh responses.
